questions.text: A mobile phone is available for ₹39,300 cash payment, or for ₹7,450 cash down payment and three equal yearly instalments. If the shopkeeper charges interest at the rate of 20% per annum, compounded annually, what is the amount of instalment (in ₹)?

A dealer fixed the price of an article 24% above the cost of production. While selling it, he allows a discount of 15%on the fixed price and makes a profit of ₹27. Find the cost of production of the article.

Next month, he buys ₹70,000 with a rebate of 10% and tax 12%. What is the percentage change in his investment from the first month to the second month?
